verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a payments and commerce platform, since self-hostable alternatives exist, so the axis applies. Every item in the evidence describes Square as a hosted service reached through its APIs, SDKs and sandbox, and nothing shows the core product can be deployed on your own infrastructure. The locally runnable MCP server is only a client-side bridge to Square's hosted APIs, not a self-hosted instance of the core product.
